about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn about our history, vision and mission
about.introText1: Founded in 1990, Polish University of Communications is located in Warsaw, the capital of Poland. It is a comprehensive university characterized by information and communication technology, with coordinated development of engineering, science, management and liberal arts.
about.introText2: For over thirty years, the university has adhered to the educational philosophy of 'Innovation, Excellence, Openness, Responsibility', committed to cultivating high-quality talents with international vision, innovative spirit and practical ability. The university has complete teaching facilities and strong faculty, and has established cooperative relations with 100+ renowned universities worldwide, providing students with a broad international exchange platform.
about.introText3: The university has achieved fruitful research results in cutting-edge fields such as artificial intelligence, communication engineering, and data science, with multiple research results reaching international leading levels, making important contributions to the information industry development of Poland and even Europe.
about.historyText1: Founded in 1990, Polish University of Communications is Poland's first higher education institution focused on communications and information technology. For over thirty years, the university has adhered to the philosophy of 'academic freedom, innovation leadership', cultivating outstanding engineering and management talents.
about.historyText2: The university has a main campus in Warsaw and two branch campuses in Krakow and Gdansk, with a total construction area of 450,000 square meters. The library collection exceeds 2 million volumes, with over 120 electronic resource databases.
about.missionText: Committed to cultivating outstanding talents with international vision and innovative spirit, promoting scientific and technological progress, and serving social development. Our goal is to become a world-top research university, leading the development of global technology in communications, computer science and electronic information.

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.subtitle: Join us and embark on an excellent academic journey
admissions.overviewText: PUC recruits outstanding students from around the world, offering degree education at undergraduate, master and doctoral levels. We welcome outstanding students with innovative spirit and global vision to apply.
admissions.undergraduateText: Undergraduate programs cover communications, computer science, electronic information and other major fields, with a four-year system. Applicants need to have a high school diploma and pass our entrance examination or provide equivalent achievement proof.
admissions.graduateText: Master programs last 2-3 years, doctoral programs last 3-5 years. Applicants need to have a bachelor's or master's degree in a related field and pass our entrance examination.
admissions.internationalText: We warmly welcome international students to apply, offering various scholarships and financial aid programs. International students need to provide language proficiency proof (English or Polish).
admissions.contactText: If you have any questions about admissions, please contact our admissions office through the following methods:

campus.title: Campus Life
campus.subtitle: Colorful campus culture, warm learning and living environment
campus.overviewText: PUC has modern campus facilities, providing students with excellent learning and living environments. The campus has libraries, laboratories, sports venues, student dormitories and other facilities.
campus.dormText: The university provides various types of student dormitories, with rooms equipped with basic furniture and network interfaces. On-campus dormitories are within a 10-minute walk from teaching buildings.
campus.foodText: There are multiple student dining halls on campus, offering Chinese, Western, Halal and other options. The dining environment is comfortable and reasonably priced.
campus.sportsText: The university has standard track and field grounds, indoor gymnasiums, swimming pools, tennis courts and other sports facilities, regularly hosting sports events.
campus.clubsText: The university has over 100 student clubs, covering academics, arts, sports, public welfare and other fields, enriching students' extracurricular life.

facilities.title: Modern Library
facilities.desc: Collection of over 1 million volumes, providing quiet study spaces and rich electronic resources, 24-hour study area available.

facilities.desc: Standard track and field, swimming pool, basketball gym, badminton gym, etc. Fully equipped to meet diverse sports needs.

facilities.desc: Multiple cafeterias and coffee shops, providing Chinese and Western dining options, meeting different taste needs, food safety guaranteed.

facilities.title: Student Dormitory
facilities.desc: Comfortable student apartments, equipped with AC, private bathroom, high-speed internet, providing safe and warm living environment.

activities.desc: The 10th Campus Culture Festival with the theme "Innovation · Integration · Future", covering literary performances, tech exhibitions, creative markets and other rich activities.

activities.title: Academic Lectures
